text: The team agreed to develop a project plan including cost, timeline, and market considerations.
The plan should be delivered as a written document covering functional design, technical design, required team size, timeframe, budget, and market approach, with two weeks as the acceptable deadline.
Key issues identified include an unclear project goal and scope (remote control vs monitor) causing misalignment, and the lack of documentation hindering funding approval.

Next steps assign responsibilities: Usability designer will start determining the functional design with Ed and Christine for usability and market viability; Christine and Ed will develop the cost structure and market plan; PM will distribute slides to all attendees after the meeting, with coordination with Ed and Christine.
